attributes.action: Cancel the £10 billion pledge to Ukraine & redirect funds to domestic services.
attributes.additional_details: The UK is facing deep economic challenges, stretched public services, and cost-of-living pressures. While international solidarity is debated, we believe that committing £10 billion in taxpayer-backed economic and export-finance support is an improper use of public funds when domestic infrastructure and social security require urgent investment. We call for a parliamentary debate and a reassessment of foreign financial commitments.
attributes.background: We urge the UK Government to reverse or pause the £10 billion funding and loan-guarantee package announced for Ukraine in the 2026 Budget, and instead reallocate these financial resources to address domestic public spending priorities, healthcare, and the cost-of-living crisis in the United Kingdom.
